info.title: CBS API
info.description:
Simplified core banking system: customers, loan products, loans, ledger and end of day.

Authentication uses a bearer token. Call `POST /api/auth/login` with `{"username": "...", "password": "..."}`, then click **Authorize** and paste the `accessToken` from the response. Each operation needs the permission its description names.

tags.name: Users
tags.description: User administration. Administrators never choose passwords: creating a user or resetting a password returns a one-time password, shown only in that response, which the user must change at first login.

tags.name: Roles
tags.description: Roles and the permissions they bundle. Changes apply to every holder from their next request.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Login, logout, token refresh, the current user and password changes. Send the token from login as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every other request.

tags.name: Loans
tags.description: The loan lifecycle: APPLIED → APPROVED → ACTIVE → CLOSED, with REJECTED and WRITTEN_OFF as the other ends. Every money movement is posted to the ledger.

tags.name: Loan products
tags.description: The loan products on offer. A loan keeps a copy of its product, so changes to the catalog never affect existing loans.

tags.name: Customers
tags.description: Individuals and lending groups, identity checks (KYC) and customer status.

tags.name: Operations
tags.description: The business date and the end-of-day batch.

tags.name: Ledger
tags.description: The double-entry general ledger: chart of accounts, balances, statements, manual entries and period close.

tags.name: Audit
tags.description: The record of every changing request, including refused and failed ones.

put.description: Sets the user's roles to exactly the set given. Refused if no active user would be left holding `USER_MANAGE`. Requires `USER_MANAGE`.
Sets the role's permissions to exactly the set given. Refused if no active user would be left holding `USER_MANAGE`. Requires `ROLE_MANAGE`.

get.description: Every user, without password hashes. Requires `USER_MANAGE`.

post.description: Creates an active user with the given roles and returns their one-time password. Usernames are unique and every role must exist. Requires `USER_MANAGE`.
Lifts a lockout after failed logins before it expires. Requires `USER_MANAGE`.
Issues a new one-time password, returned only in this response, clears any lockout and requires a change at the next login. Requires `USER_MANAGE`.
Lets a disabled user log in again. Requires `USER_MANAGE`.
The user can no longer log in, and tokens they hold stop working on the next request. You cannot disable yourself, or the last active user holding `USER_MANAGE`. Requires `USER_MANAGE`.

get.description: Every role with its permissions. Requires `ROLE_MANAGE`.

post.description: Creates a role with a set of permissions. Names are unique. Requires `ROLE_MANAGE`.

get.description: Products open for new loans, ordered by code. Requires login only.

post.description: Adds an active product: who may borrow, interest method and day count, repayment frequency, the allowed ranges of rate, principal and instalments, disbursement fees, penalty, the order repayments settle what is due (default: penalty, fee, interest, principal) and the ledger accounts it posts to. Rates are annual percentages; amounts are decimal strings. Requires `PRODUCT_MANAGE`.
Stops new loans on the product. Loans already made are unaffected. Retiring a retired product does nothing. Requires `PRODUCT_MANAGE`.

get.description: Every loan in the given status. Requires login only.

post.description: Records an application in status APPLIED. The borrower must be eligible for credit, and the terms must be allowed by the product for that kind of borrower; every broken rule is listed in the error. Give exactly one of `annualRatePercent` and `monthlyRatePercent`. Requires `LOAN_APPLY`.

Removes an ACTIVE loan's principal from the portfolio against the provision held, charging any shortfall to provision expense, and reverses accrued interest and penalty that were never paid. The loan becomes WRITTEN_OFF. Requires `LOAN_WRITE_OFF`.

get.description: Every repayment taken on the loan, including reversed ones. Requires login only.

post.description: Accrues interest through the business date, then applies the payment to what is due (in the product's allocation order, oldest instalment first) and any remainder to future instalments. A payment above the payoff amount is refused; one that settles the loan closes it. `reference` is the payment's unique id: resending it returns the original repayment instead of taking the money twice. `paidInto` defaults to the product's disbursement source account. Requires `REPAYMENT_TAKE`.

Reverses a repayment in the ledger and undoes its allocation. Only the latest repayment still in force can be reversed; reversing the one that closed a loan reopens it. Resending the same `reversalReference` does nothing. Requires `REPAYMENT_REVERSE`.
Moves an APPLIED loan to REJECTED, with an optional note. Requires `LOAN_APPROVE`.

Pays out an APPROVED loan on the business date and makes it ACTIVE. The repayment schedule is fixed from that date and disbursement fees are deducted from the amount paid out. Posts: Dr loan portfolio, Cr disbursement source and fee income. Requires `LOAN_DISBURSE`.
Moves an APPLIED loan to APPROVED. The approver must not be the user who entered the application (maker-checker), and the borrower must still be eligible. Requires `LOAN_APPROVE`.

Closes every month up to and including `through` (format `YYYY-MM`), which must be before the current business month. Nothing can be posted into a closed month afterwards, and closed months are never reopened. Requires `PERIOD_CLOSE`.

Posts a balanced entry on the business date; debits must equal credits in each currency. Every account must exist and be open, and the period must not be closed. `id` is chosen by the caller: resending the same entry returns the original, while the same id with different content is refused. Entries are never changed afterwards; correct one with a new entry. Requires `JOURNAL_POST`.

For every active loan: accrues interest through the business date, charges penalty on amounts overdue beyond the grace days, classifies the loan by days past due and sets its provision. Each loan is processed on its own; failures are reported and the rest carry on. Only if every loan succeeded (`complete` is true) does the business date move to the next day. Safe to rerun after fixing a failure. Requires `END_OF_DAY_RUN`.
Returns a blacklisted customer to active. Requires `CUSTOMER_STATUS_MANAGE`.
Adds a customer to an active group, within the group size limit. They may not already be in another active group. Requires `GROUP_MANAGE`.
Removes a member from an active group. The leader cannot be removed (change the leader first), and the group may not drop below the minimum size. Requires `GROUP_MANAGE`.
Makes another member the group's leader. Requires `GROUP_MANAGE`.
Records that the individual's identity was checked and confirmed. KYC must be pending and the document unexpired. The optional note is kept with the decision. Requires `KYC_DECIDE`.
Records that the individual's identity could not be confirmed; they are then not eligible for credit. KYC must be pending. Requires `KYC_DECIDE`.
Closes the customer for good. An individual must first be removed from any active group; closing a group frees its members to join another. Requires `CUSTOMER_STATUS_MANAGE`.
Stops an active customer from getting new credit. Existing loans are unaffected. Requires `CUSTOMER_STATUS_MANAGE`.

Creates an active individual with KYC pending. The applicant must meet the minimum age on the business date, the identity document must not be expired, and the same document may not be registered twice. Requires `CUSTOMER_REGISTER`.

Creates an active lending group. The leader must be one of the members, the member count must be within the group size limits, and no member may already be in another active group. Requires `GROUP_MANAGE`.
Exchanges the token sent with this request, which must still be valid, for a new one with a fresh expiry. The old token stops working at once. Requires login only.

Replaces the logged-in user's password. The current password must be right, and the new one must meet the password policy and not repeat a recent password; every broken rule is listed in the error. Requires login only.
Ends the token sent with this request: it is refused from now on, even before it expires. Answered with 204. Requires login only.

Checks the username and password and returns a signed token (`accessToken`) with its expiry and the user's permissions. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every other request. Repeated failures lock the account for a while; disabled and locked users are refused. Open to everyone.

get.description: One user by id. Requires `USER_MANAGE`.
One role by name. Requires `ROLE_MANAGE`.

delete.description: Deletes a role. Refused while any user still holds it. Requires `ROLE_MANAGE`.

get.description: One product by code, active or retired. Requires login only.
Every permission the application checks. They are fixed in code; roles decide who holds them. Requires `ROLE_MANAGE`.
The loan's state and balances, including the payoff amount. Requires login only.
The instalments with their due dates and what is paid on each. A loan has a schedule only once it is disbursed. Requires login only.
Amounts past due on the business date and days past due, counted from the oldest unpaid due date. Requires login only.
Every account with a non-zero balance in the currency, as debit or credit, with the totals. `balanced` is true when debits equal credits. Requires `LEDGER_VIEW`.
One journal entry with all its lines. Requires `LEDGER_VIEW`.
Every ledger account with its type and whether it is closed. Requires `LEDGER_VIEW`.
Opening balance, every line posted to the account between `from` and `to` (inclusive, by posting date) with a running balance, and the closing balance. Requires `LEDGER_VIEW`.
The account's current balance in one currency, as net debit: positive for a debit balance, negative for a credit balance. Requires `LEDGER_VIEW`.

One page of every customer, individuals and groups, most recently registered first. `page` counts from 0; `size` is 1 to 100. `total` is the number of customers across every page. Requires login only.
An individual or a group by id. Requires login only.
Every loan the customer has borrowed, in any status. Requires login only.

Whether the customer may take new credit on the business date. An individual must be active, KYC verified and hold an unexpired identity document; a group must be active and every member eligible. Requires login only.
The accounting day the institution is working in. It moves only through end of day, never with the wall clock. Requires login only.
The logged-in user, their permissions, and whether they must change their password before working. Requires login only.
Every POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE in arrival order, with the user, the business date and the outcome. Pass `user` to see only one user's requests. Requires `AUDIT_VIEW`.
